editorial: Today's technology agenda is dominated by autonomous skill sets and open source agent architectures. In particular, the Hermes model published by NousResearch allows developers to build their own AI assistants in a customizable structure.

items.title: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
items.summary: Last30days-skill, which conducts research on platforms such as Reddit, This Python-based tool combines information from different digital sources to create comprehensive reports on current issues.

items.title: opencv/opencv
items.summary: OpenCV, an open source computer vision library, offers a wide range of tools for image processing and machine learning applications. This library, developed in C++ language, serves as a standard infrastructure in real-time visual data analysis processes.

items.title: Leonxlnx/taste-skill
items.summary: Taste-Skill is a system that enables more qualified results to be obtained by reducing monotonous and commonplace expressions in the content produced by artificial intelligence models. It allows users to personalize AI outputs and improve language quality.

items.title: NousResearch/hermes-agent
items.summary: Developed by NousResearch, Hermes Agent is an autonomous AI agent that expands its capabilities by learning over time through user interactions. This Python-based system is designed to support personalized task management and continuous learning processes.

items.title: lfnovo/open-notebook
items.summary: Open-notebook offers an open-source alternative to Google NotebookLM, giving users more flexibility and customization of their documents. Developed with TypeScript, this project brings personal information management and artificial intelligence-supported content analysis processes to local or customizable environments.

items.title: yikart/AiToEarn
items.summary: AiToEarn is a TypeScript-based platform that enables users to manage their monetization processes through AI-powered automations. The project offers an open infrastructure to developers by combining autonomous task execution and artificial intelligence-based earning models.

items.title: aaif-goose/goose
items.summary: Goose is an open-source AI agent that goes beyond code suggestions and automates software installation, execution, editing and testing. Developed with the Rust language, this tool aims to manage software development workflows end-to-end by integrating with different major language models (LLM).

items.title: Crosstalk-Solutions/project-nomad
items.summary: Project N.O.M.A.D is an offline survival computer that provides access to critical tools, information resources and local artificial intelligence models in environments that do not require an internet connection. The portable system aims to provide the user with independent data and processing capacity in emergency scenarios.

items.title: ggml-org/llama.cpp
items.summary: Llama.cpp is a C and C++ based inference library that enables large language models to be run efficiently on standard hardware. The software makes it easier to run artificial intelligence models on local devices with its low memory usage and high performance-oriented structure.

items.title: RyanCodrai/turbovec
items.summary: Built on the TurboQuant infrastructure, turbovec is a high-performance vector index tool developed with the Rust language. Thanks to Python bindings, it allows developers to perform vector-based search operations quickly and efficiently.

items.title: TapXWorld/ChinaTextbook
items.summary: The ChinaTextbook repository offers a digital archive of textbooks used in the Chinese education curriculum from primary school to university level in portable document format (PDF). This resource provides a central access point to a wide range of academic materials.

items.title: openai/plugins
items.summary: OpenAI plugins provide a framework that enables language models to access current data and interact with external systems. This structure allows generative AI models to perform real-time operations and connect with third-party applications.

items.title: refactoringhq/tolaria
items.summary: Tolaria is a desktop application developed for managing Markdown-based knowledge bases. Written in TypeScript, this tool makes it easy to keep personal documentation and notes systems organized.

items.title: HunxByts/GhostTrack
items.summary: Python-based GhostTrack is a tool that allows location tracking via mobile numbers. This open source software was developed to detect the geographical data of the target number.

items.title: microsoft/pg_durable
items.summary: Developed by Microsoft, pg_durable is a library designed to manage durable execution processes on PostgreSQL. Written in Rust, the tool enables complex workflows to run within the database in a fault-tolerant and persistent manner.

items.title: LLMs are eroding my software engineering career and I don't know what to do
items.summary: The integration of large language models into software development processes creates a transformation that questions the value of traditional coding practices. Software engineers need to redefine their technical competencies and focus on human-centered problem-solving skills in the face of the increasing influence of automation.

items.title: Building from zero after addiction, prison, and a felony
items.summary: Software developer Gavin Ray shares his career journey and technical proficiency experience, which he built from scratch after addiction and incarceration. Combining personal development with the discipline of professional software development, this narrative addresses the impact of difficult living conditions on career goals in the technology sector.

items.title: How's Linear so fast? A technical breakdown
items.summary: Linear uses a combination of optimistic UI updates and data caching strategies to optimize application performance. The software minimizes latency by making interactions with local state management instantaneous, without waiting for server responses.

items.title: The 29th International Obfuscated C Code Contest (IOCCC) 2025 Winners
items.summary: The International Obfuscated C Code Contest announced the winners of 2025 and rewarded the most complex and difficult to understand C source codes. The competition continues to showcase creative and mysterious software development practices that push the boundaries of programming languages.

items.title: Show HN: Lathe – Use LLMs to learn a new domain, not skip past it
items.summary: Lathe is an educational tool that uses large language models to teach technical topics rather than doing the work for the user. It creates resource-supported hands-on lessons through a native interface that encourages software developers to write code manually.

items.title: nvidia/LocateAnything-3B
items.summary: Developed by NVIDIA, LocateAnything-3D is an image-text-to-text model that performs object localization tasks by processing visual and textual inputs. The model is designed to identify objects in complex scenes and specify the coordinates of these objects with text-based outputs.

items.title: google/gemma-4-12B-it
items.summary: The Gemma 2 9B-based Gemma-4-12B-it model developed by Google offers a multimodal structure that can process different data types such as text and images. The model aims to interact between different data formats with the ability to process any type of input (any-to-any).

items.title: unsloth/gemma-4-12b-it-GGUF
items.summary: Optimized by Unsloth, the Gemma 4-12B model offers a multimodal structure that can process visual and text data. This model in GGUF format accelerates text-based visual analysis processes on local devices with low memory usage.

items.title: google/gemma-4-12B
items.summary: Released by Google, Gemma-4-12B is designed as a versatile multi-modal model (any-to-any model) capable of converting between different data types. This model offers a flexible artificial intelligence experience by processing various types of input such as text and images.

items.title: ideogram-ai/ideogram-4-fp8
items.summary: Developed by Ideogram, ideogram-4-fp8 is a floating-point 8-bit (FP8) precision model that provides low memory usage in text-to-image conversion processes. This model offers faster processing capacity by increasing hardware efficiency in rendering operations.
